name: Arrabon Icon Assets v2
rules: Alpha Lock is the only primary app icon.
Seal is only for secondary trust/legal contexts.
Seal must not be used as a small normal UI icon.
Simplified Alpha Lock is used for favicon.
Funded means escrow/lock/held funds and uses Antique Gold.
Released means check/success and uses green.
Status and utility icons use 2px stroke with rounded caps and joins.
Gold is brand/trust accent, not universal semantic status color.
cleanup: open.svg standalone dot fixed to muted #6C6C6C
time icon distinguished from transaction pending
